rationale: Record the Windows embedded-host frame-clock scheduling change for the watched render family. The change is confined to Pulp-owned host cadence in core/view/platform/win/plugin_view_host_win.cpp: it advances FrameClock and HostFramePump from an attached HWND WM_TIMER while preserving dirty/continuous/scripted-idle gating. It does not change transferred renderer, canvas, Skia, Graphite, Dawn, or resource implementation authority, and it does not prescribe Graphite threading. Linux scheduling (#8448), production capture (#8457), and P0-A observability (#8458) remain separate packets.
